name: Transit
pitch: An architecture or infrastructure talk that walks the audience through a system the way a metro map walks a city.

illustration.medium: flat vector, subway-map-style diagram on off-white
illustration.line: 3px strokes in solid transit-line colors, strictly horizontal/vertical/45-degree
illustration.shapes: circles for stations, straight line segments for routes, occasional ring for an interchange
illustration.palette_use: off-white background dominant, one red transit line and one blue transit line as the two accent colors, used the way a map legend would
illustration.avoid: gradients, curves that aren't 45-degree diagonals, photorealism, more than two line colors at once
